incoming.name: British monarchy
incoming.excerpt: Sandringham House, a privately owned country house near the village of Sandringham, Norfolk, is typically used from Christmas to the end of January.

incoming.name: Edward VII of the United Kingdom
incoming.excerpt: Edward and his wife established Marlborough House as their London residence and Sandringham House in Norfolk as their country retreat.

incoming.name: Edward VIII of the United Kingdom
incoming.excerpt: The new King and Queen were also forced to pay Edward for Sandringham House and Balmoral Castle.

incoming.name: Elizabeth II of the United Kingdom
incoming.excerpt: She also spends time at Balmoral Castle, in Scotland, and at Sandringham House, in Norfolk.

incoming.name: George VI of the United Kingdom
incoming.excerpt: George VI was born on 14 December 1895 at York Cottage, on the Sandringham Estate, Norfolk.

outgoing.excerpt: One part of the house was destroyed in a fire during the preparations for Prince Edward's 50th birthday in 1891, and later rebuilt.

outgoing.name: George V of the United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: Edward and Alexandra's sons, Prince Albert Victor and Prince George, for example, had very small bedrooms.

outgoing.name: George VI of the United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: Queen Alexandra, her son George V, and grandson George VI all died at Sandringham.
